content: NeuroCare is an AI-assisted doctor appointment platform designed to help patients find suitable doctors based on their illness and location.
Patients can request an appointment with a doctor. The appointment request is reviewed by the administrator before the appointment date and time are confirmed.
The administrator confirms the appointment date and time. The doctor should not see the appointment request before the administrator approves it.
Doctors can log into the platform using their email address and OTP authentication.
The AI system can help suggest doctors based on the patient's illness and nearby location.
Doctors can provide prescriptions to patients after consultation.
